get.description: Get limit orders with pagination support

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric chain id, leave empty for all chains.

parameters.name: poolId
parameters.description: Optional. Pool ID to filter orders by principal/swap tokens.

parameters.name: maker
parameters.description: Optional. Maker address filter.

parameters.name: makerAsset
parameters.description: Optional. Maker asset address filter.

parameters.name: takerAsset
parameters.description: Optional. Taker asset address filter.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Optional. Order side filter.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional. Order status filter — single value (?status=OPEN) or repeated (?status=OPEN&status=PARTIALLY_FILLED). Filtering by OPEN also returns PARTIALLY_FILLED orders (both are fillable). When omitted, defaults to the fillable book (OPEN + PARTIALLY_FILLED); pass explicit statuses to read terminal rows.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional. Maximum number of items to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Optional. Number of items to skip.

parameters.name: nextCursor
parameters.description: Optional. Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Legacy timestamp cursors (ISO 8601) are still accepted.

premium.description: Unit: percent. Informational only - authoritative pricing lives in the order's amount-getter extension data (COR-35 ratified units).
